title: France Unrest Triggers Global Yield Spike, Gold Breaks Major Support, Bitcoin Stumbles
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: France unrest pushed yields up worldwide; US 10y near 5.35% and futures trade inversely to yields.
Massive public and private debt issuance (e.g. SpaceX $40B) lets buyers demand higher yields, keeping yields elevated.
Expects a Great-Depression-style collapse around 2029-2030 from debt and money printing, but still net long for now.
Dollar keeps pushing up on France unrest, weighing on gold.
China's 23rd straight month of gold buying supports a gold-backed yuan reserve ambition long term.

calls.reason: Double top at the Aug 13 all-time high suggests a pullback today if yields rise, but still in bullish zone; 8000 is a confluence of two long-term trend lines (from 2024 highs and the COVID low).
calls.quote: I'm going to remain bullish on this market... My upside target remains around 8,000 on the S&P 500

calls.condition: If oil gets a daily close below the ~88.75 trend line, expects a drop to $78-79 within days.
calls.reason: Oil saved its ascending trend line at yesterday's close, so no breakdown yet; a daily close below it would trigger a ~$10 drop.
calls.quote: a daily close below that and I do think that oil goes to 78. Basically a $10 drop in a matter of days.

calls.condition: If gold fails to recapture/breaks 4,100, likely 3,950; below 3,950, 3,500, where he would buy physical.
calls.reason: Gold is below its major support line as yields and the dollar rise; long-term holder who would buy physical at 3,500.
calls.quote: If it breaks 4,100, we're likely headed to 3950... 3500 is still that level

calls.condition: A break of the key trend line support would dictate a drop to $55; still expects a return to ~$50 (1980/2011 highs).
calls.reason: Silver sitting on its trend line; 'return to the scene of the crime' back to the $50 breakout level would be the major buy opportunity.
calls.quote: That would dictate a drop to $55... there's a retrace to the scene of the crime... right around $50

calls.condition: As long as 81,000 holds, bullish consolidation (bull flag); a daily close below 81,000 targets ~75,500.
calls.reason: Bull flag consolidation intact above 81k; he personally suspects a bigger pullback but defers to the chart.
calls.quote: As long as we hold 81, neutral to bullish bias has to be maintained on a probability factor.

calls.reason: Parallel channel line off major ascending trend gives a shortable level around 440-445.

notes: Date: host gives no calendar date, but says the FOMC minutes are 'today at 2 p.m.' and refers to Monday's 5.35% yield high, i.e. Wednesday 2026-10-07 (matches listing; the 2026-10-08 Verified Investing stream confirms minutes were 'yesterday'). BAC '5237' read as $52.37 and direction (long at gap fill) is implied, not stated. MU price ~$1,022 as quoted. 10y yield ~5.35% and DXY strength discussed but no forward call; natural gas mentioned only in passing. Long-term 2029-2030 collapse view kept in macro_themes, not scored as an ES long_term bias.
